$Comment: Half a frost stack (2026-10-21: every hit of the king applies frost; the quick ones less). With AT_Ice_King_Frost_Half on the target: clear it and run AT_Ice_King_Frost_Hit (one stack, freeze at 5, warmth potion and freeze guard respected there). Without it: put it on for 20 s and nothing else. Used by the zap, the punches and the nunchuck hits 1-2. 2026-10-21 (snow shell): nothing at all on a target that is frozen right now (AT_Ice_King_Freeze or the ultimate's AT_Ice_King_Freeze_Ultimate), not even the weak slow or the half-stack flag: the client drops an entity's active ModelVFX (Freeze's snow shell) whenever another effect is removed from it or a visual effect is renewed (Mob Battle finding, tested), even though the server still has the freeze on. The freeze guard after the freeze still gives only the weak slow. 2026-10-22 (playtest: the king's attacks froze his own ice pillars, that must never happen; they may take damage, so the player can hide behind one, but never frost or freeze): targets with the marker AT_Ice_King_Frost_Immune (the pillar AT_Ice_King_Ice_Pillar and AT_Ice_King_Lightning_Stuck put it on themselves) skip the frost/freeze part; the damage still lands.
